## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The empty-criteria regression should be fixed because it marks requirements without evidence as proven. This review read both changed files and all available tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request changes how requirement proof status is calculated and adds a helper that checks whether every entry in a nonempty batch is reviewed.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/proof.py:3 — correctness — Restore the nonempty-criteria guard — For `criteria=[]`, `requirement_proven` now returns `True` instead of `False`. Both `sum(...)` and `len(criteria)` evaluate to zero, so removing `bool(criteria)` changes the empty-input result. — Requirements with no criteria can be incorrectly reported as proven.
